description: This file defines the CategoryService interface, which declares methods for managing categories within a merchant store, including listing, retrieving, adding, and counting categories based on various criteria.

classes.name: CategoryService
classes.description: Interface for category management operations within a merchant store, including listing, retrieval, addition, and counting of categories.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories by their lineage within a store.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a specific SEO URL.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the description of a category in a specific language.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category to a parent category.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories by their parent category.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories by store and parent category.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories by name within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories within a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code within a store.

methods.name: listByStore with Language
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a category.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories by depth within a store.

methods.name: listByDepth with Language
methods.description: Lists categories by depth within a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories by lineage using store code.

methods.name: getByCode with storeCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a category by SEO URL.

methods.name: listByParent with Language
methods.description: Lists categories by parent category and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category by ID and language.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products in categories, returning category code and product count.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Lists categories by a list of codes within a store and language.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Lists categories by a list of IDs within a store and language.

search-terms: list categories by store and parent
